artifact.name: P2-A3a paired primary validation-only training specification

not_yet_authorized: P2-A3b matched DeepSets, relation shuffle, behavior-breaking counterfactual, and channel-ablation runs
test-based threshold, seed, checkpoint, or feature selection
stage_boundary.staging_reason: Run the cheaper predeclared paired performance gate first. If the candidate fails against either reference, the frozen P2 stop policy forbids spending additional runs to rescue it; if it passes, P2-A3b construct-validity experiments are frozen and run next. Passing P2-A3a alone does not establish the primary behavior claim and does not unlock test.

input_contract.path_policy: The frozen train and validation manifests are read directly. The combined test-bearing index is never opened. PT paths are replaced only after an exact one-to-one graph_id/split join to the frozen P2-A2F conversion manifest.
input_contract.artifact_integrity: Every run verifies frozen file SHA256 values, exact graph membership, PT path uniqueness, current PT byte sizes, and P2-A2F PASS status before constructing a loader. P2-A2F already independently reloaded and SHA-audited all 37,500 new PT files.

controlled_zero.role: same P2 dimensions and code path with every appended semantic slot fixed to zero

fixed_training_contract.component_weighting_rationale: This is the accepted current P1 practical training reference: it improved validation AP in the completed seed-1001 mechanism audit, whereas AdamW and source-preserving R2 were rejected. Applying it identically to all three representations isolates representation gain; the predeclared sdist and Datadog subgroup gates guard its known source-mass tradeoff.

paired_initialization_contract.candidate_and_controlled_zero: For every seed, both runs use identical model dimensions, architecture code, deterministic seed setup, and parameter creation order. Their complete initial state_dict SHA256 values must be bit-identical in CPU preflight.
paired_initialization_contract.practical_reference: The practical reference has smaller input projections, so tensors with changed shapes cannot be bit-identical. It still uses the same seed and every non-representation training setting.

resume_contract.within_run: The unchanged base trainer atomically saves last_state.pt after every completed epoch, including optimizer and RNG states. Ctrl+C can discard only the current incomplete epoch; rerunning the identical matrix command resumes from the last completed epoch.
resume_contract.across_matrix: A completed validation_result.json is independently validated and skipped. The first incomplete configuration resumes, and all later pending configurations remain untouched.
resume_contract.configuration_drift: The checkpoint binds the wrapper, freeze manifest, representation, dimensions, PT conversion manifest, hyperparameters, and seed SHA/config fields. Any mismatch fails closed.
resume_contract.concurrency: A nonblocking process lock refuses a second simultaneous matrix runner in the same output root.

primary_gate_contract.bootstrap_interval: two-sided percentile 95% interval using numpy quantile linear interpolation

precision_constrained_threshold.objective: maximum pooled recall over distinct observed score thresholds with all ties included

primary_gate_contract.pass_action: freeze and implement P2-A3b construct-validity experiments; test remains locked
primary_gate_contract.fail_action: stop P2 candidate after validation; do not read or generate test artifacts

time_budget_advisory_not_a_selection_rul.estimated_matrix_wall_clock_single_gpu: approximately 9 to 12 hours, depending on early stopping and the larger P2 input projections
